related.title: MESSENGER 水星探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付弦長推導、排程甘特表與未完成項優先序，明示直線模型限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver chord derivation,schedule and unfinished-item priorities with straight-line-model limits.
related.difference: 在合成行星影像中校正入射角影響，避免把照明差異當材質差異。
related.differenceEn: Correct illumination-angle effects in synthetic planetary imagery so lighting is not mistaken for composition.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 由直角三角形求半弦長 8000 km，再乘二除速度。
計算 cos60°=0.5，除去照明項，再反代重現 0.2。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Use the right triangle to obtain half-chord 8000 km,then double and divide by speed.

related.title: Ingenuity 火星直升機
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付弦長推導、排程甘特表與未完成項優先序，明示直線模型限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver chord derivation,schedule and unfinished-item priorities with straight-line-model limits.
related.difference: 以理想致動盤模型估算懸停誘導功率，識別實機功耗中被忽略的項目。
related.differenceEn: Estimate hover induced power with an ideal actuator disk and identify omitted real power demands.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 由直角三角形求半弦長 8000 km，再乘二除速度。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成重量 W=6 N、大氣密度 ρ=0.02 kg/m³、有效盤面 A=1 m²；盤面不重複加算。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：Pi=6^1.5/sqrt(2×0.02×1)。 結果約 73.4847 W。理想懸停 Pi=W^(3/2)/sqrt(2ρA)；不含槳剖面阻力、機械損失與非均勻入流。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Use the right triangle to obtain half-chord 8000 km,then double and divide by speed.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use synthetic W=6 N, density 0.02 kg/m³ and effective disk area 1 m² without double-counting overlapping disks. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: Pi=6^1.5/sqrt(2×0.02×1). Result ≈ 73.4847 W. Ideal hover Pi=W^(3/2)/sqrt(2ρA), excluding profile drag, mechanical loss and nonuniform inflow.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
